edges.reason: The onlyOwner modifier requires msg.sender == owner before ownership can be staged.
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender == newOwner before promoting the pending owner.
transferAnyERC20Token is gated by onlyOwner, restricting msg.sender to the owner.
transfer debits balances[msg.sender], so the caller address flows into the balances mapping.
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] using the caller-controlled address.
transferFrom decrements allowed[from][msg.sender] using the caller address.
approveAndCall stores allowed[msg.sender][spender] and forwards msg.sender to the callback.
Parameter a flows into the addition performed by safeAdd.
Parameter b participates in the a + b addition whose overflow is guarded by require(c >= a).
Parameter a flows into the subtraction performed by safeSub.
Parameter b is subtracted with an underflow guard require(b <= a).
Parameter a flows into the multiplication performed by safeMul.
Parameter b participates in a * b whose overflow is guarded by require(a == 0 || c / a == b).
Parameter a flows into the division performed by safeDiv.
Parameter b is the divisor guarded by require(b > 0) before a / b.
The candidate owner parameter is written to state variable newOwner.
tokenOwner indexes the balances mapping returned by balanceOf.
Recipient address is credited in balances[to] during transfer.
Token amount flows into safeSub and safeAdd calls in transfer.
spender indexes the allowed mapping in approve.
tokens is stored as the allowance value in approve.
from is the account debited in transferFrom.
to is the account credited in transferFrom.
tokens is the amount removed from balances and allowance in transferFrom.
tokenOwner indexes the allowed mapping in allowance.
spender indexes the inner allowance mapping.
spender receives the allowance and is the target of the external call.
tokens is stored as allowance and forwarded to receiveApproval.
data is forwarded verbatim to the spender contract callback.
tokenAddress is cast to ERC20Interface and used as the call target.
tokens is passed to the external ERC20 transfer call.
transferOwnership writes the pending owner into the newOwner state variable.
acceptOwnership promotes newOwner into the owner state variable.
acceptOwnership resets newOwner to address(0) after promotion.
Constructor initializes the symbol state variable.
Constructor initializes the name state variable.
Constructor initializes the decimals state variable.
Constructor sets the total supply state variable.
Constructor assigns the whole supply to the initial holder in the balances mapping.
totalSupply reads the _totalSupply state variable.
totalSupply also reads balances[address(0)] to net out burned tokens.
balanceOf reads the balances state mapping.
transfer reads and writes the balances state mapping.
approve writes the allowed state mapping.
transferFrom updates the balances state mapping.
transferFrom decrements the allowed state mapping.
allowance reads the allowed state mapping.
approveAndCall writes the allowed state mapping before calling out.
transfer uses safeSub to debit the sender balance.
transfer uses safeAdd to credit the recipient balance.
transferFrom uses safeSub for both the balance and allowance debits.
transferFrom uses safeAdd to credit the recipient balance.
approveAndCall invokes receiveApproval on an attacker-supplied spender contract, enabling reentrancy before the allowance state is fully settled.
transferAnyERC20Token performs an external ERC20 transfer call on an arbitrary tokenAddress supplied by the owner.
safeAdd writes the checked sum into its return local c.
safeSub writes the checked difference into its return local c.
safeMul writes the checked product into its return local c.
safeDiv writes the quotient into its return local c.
